name: apexfinance
description: Plataforma privada de gestão financeira, investimentos, factoring e inteligência financeira.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@apexfinance/contracts && npm run build --workspace=@apexfinance/financial-core && npm run build --workspace=@apexfinance/ui
scripts.build:apps: npm run build --workspace=@apexfinance/api && npm run build --workspace=@apexfinance/web
scripts.dev: docker compose up -d && concurrently -k -n API,WEB "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
